Command.Comment: RAGIN EDGE live mTLS + app HTTP probe to CORE (no secrets printed)

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
CERT_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/edge.crt
KEY_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/edge.key
CA_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt
API_KEY_FILE=/etc/ragin/api.key
echo CERT_FILE="$CERT_FILE"
echo KEY_FILE="$KEY_FILE"
echo CA_FILE="$CA_FILE"
echo API_KEY_FILE="$API_KEY_FILE"
CERTS_READY=0
API_KEY_READY=0
if [ -n "$CERT_FILE" ] && [ -n "$KEY_FILE" ] && [ -n "$CA_FILE" ] && [ -f "$CERT_FILE" ] && [ -f "$KEY_FILE" ] && [ -f "$CA_FILE" ]; then
  CERTS_READY=1
fi
if [ -n "$API_KEY_FILE" ] && [ -f "$API_KEY_FILE" ]; then
  API_KEY_READY=1
fi
echo CERTS_READY=$CERTS_READY
echo API_KEY_READY=$API_KEY_READY
TMPDDIR=$(mktemp -d)
echo TMPDIR=$TMPDDIR
if [ "$CERTS_READY" = "1" ] && command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ATTEMPT_OPENSSL_S_CLIENT_EDGE_TO_CORE"
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "$CA_FILE" \
    -cert "$CERT_FILE" \
    -key "$KEY_FILE" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "${TMPDDIR}/s_client_edge_to_core.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo S_CLIENT_EDGE_TO_CORE_EXIT=0
  else
    echo S_CLIENT_EDGE_TO_CORE_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- s_client output head ---"
  head -n 80 "${TMPDDIR}/s_client_edge_to_core.txt"
  echo "--- peer cert subject/issuer/eku san if returned (no keys) ---"
  if grep -q "BEGIN CERTIFICATE" "${TMPDDIR}/s_client_edge_to_core.txt" 2>/dev/null; then
    openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -ext subjectAltName,extendedKeyUsage,keyId,authorityKeyIdentifier \
      -in "${TMPDDIR}/s_client_edge_to_core.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo PEER_CERT_PARSE_FAILED
  else
    echo PEER_CERT_NOT_RETURNED
  fi
else
  echo TLS_PROBE_SKIPPED=no_certs_or_no_openssl
fi
echo APPLICATION_PROBE_START
if [ "$API_KEY_READY" = "1" ] && command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  API_KEY=$(cat "$API_KEY_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)
  echo "ATTEMPT_APPLICATION_REQUEST"
  if curl -sS --max-time 30 --cert "$CERT_FILE" --key "$KEY_FILE" --cacert "$CA_FILE" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${API_KEY}" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"session_id":"live-recovery-probe","command":"echo RAGIN_MTLS_HELLO","request_id":"rrp-'"$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"'"}' \
    https://172.31.17.217:8443/ragin/v1/command > "${TMPDDIR}/app_response.json" 2>"${TMPDDIR}/app_response_err.txt"; then
    echo APP_CURL_EXIT=0
  else
    echo APP_CURL_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- app response head ---"
  head -n 200 "${TMPDDIR}/app_response.json" 2>/dev/null || echo APP_RESPONSE_EMPTY_OR_MISSING
  echo "--- app error head ---"
  head -n 200 "${TMPDDIR}/app_response_err.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo APP_ERROR_EMPTY_OR_MISSING
else
  echo APP_PROBE_SKIPPED=no_apikey_or_no_curl
fi
rm -rf "${TMPDDIR}"
echo DONE
